G401.title: Behind the lines
G401.shortDescrition: IN Auto Drive teams must stay in their Area
G401.description: In AUTO, each DRIVE TEAM member must remain in their staged areas. A DRIVE TEAM member staged behind a HUMAN STARTING LINE may not contact anything in front of that HUMAN STARTING LINE, unless for personal or equipment safety, to press the E-Stop or A-Stop, or granted permission by a Head REFEREE or FTA.

G402.title: Let the ROBOT do its thing
G402.shortDescrition: IN Auto Drive teams May not interact with Robot or Ops Console
G402.description: In AUTO, a DRIVE TEAM member may not directly or indirectly interact with a ROBOT or an OPERATOR CONSOLE unless for personal safety, OPERATOR CONSOLE safety, or pressing an E-Stop or A-Stop. A HUMAN PLAYER entering FUEL onto the FIELD is an exception to this rule.

G403.title: Limited AUTO opponent interaction
G403.shortDescrition: IN Auto Drive teams May not interact with Robot or Ops Console
G403.description: In AUTO, a ROBOT whose BUMPERS are completely across the CENTER LINE (i.e. to the opposite side of the CENTER LINE from its ROBOT STARTING LINE) may not contact an opponent ROBOT.
